title: Drillable Flare sunburst
intent: Navigate a large hierarchy two levels at a time while retained and newly revealed sectors follow their hierarchy through each transition.

ai.create: Create a drillable Flare sunburst that renders two descendant rings below a controlled root, uses semantic node selection for pointer and keyboard navigation, and animates retained, entering, and exiting sectors by interpolating polar geometry through hierarchy relationships.
ai.maintain: Keep the full flat hierarchy as source data, preserve canonical node IDs and ancestry across root changes, leave navigation state and the center back control in the application, and keep motion centered by interpolating sector angles and radii before regenerating each path.
